verdict.rationale: Postman's first-party docs describe creating and deploying mock servers that simulate a real, always-available API, including dynamic mock responses. The Postman CLI can also start mock servers, including local ones, so consumers can build against a stand-in API. missing for 10: explicit evidence that mocks are generated from saved examples or from an API spec (Spec Hub is not tied to mocking in the evidence), independent or hands-on corroboration.
